ua3ff2d1b471d.zh: 这个工具会把这台 Mac 上的「备忘录」备份成本地的文字副本，便于在电脑上整理使用。手机上备忘录的分类和新增备忘录可以通过 iCloud 反向同步回去，也可以保持原样不动。
ua3ff2d1b471d.en: This tool backs up Notes on this Mac into local text copies, so they are easier to organize and use on the computer. Categories and newly added notes can be synced back to the phone through iCloud, or the phone can be left exactly as it is.

u5aeb18b08952.zh: 刚才系统弹过一句「无法验证开发者」——那是因为这个工具没有购买苹果的开发者签名，不是因为它有问题。macOS 对所有没签名的程序都这么提示。不放心的话，可以把代码仓库丢给任何一个 AI 帮你核对：仓库里有校验和清单，代码也是公开可读的。
u5aeb18b08952.en: macOS just said the developer could not be verified. That is because this tool does not carry a paid Apple developer signature, not because anything is wrong with it. macOS says the same about every unsigned program. To be sure, hand the repository to any AI and have it checked: there is a checksum list in the repo, and the source is readable.

u6f0d0c8de47a.zh: 下面几步都能跳过，跳过了照样能用——导入、整理、导出、归位都不需要任何配置。分类以后随时能改：卡片上直接选、拖到左边分类里，或者让「💡 智能整理」先猜一遍；内容重复的笔记用「📑 内容迭代」归成同一条的不同版本。
u6f0d0c8de47a.en: Every step below can be skipped, and skipping them all still leaves the tool fully usable — importing, organizing, exporting and filing back need no configuration. Categories can be changed any time: pick one on the card, drag a card onto a category, or let 💡 Smart sort take a first pass; notes with repeated content go into 📑 Versions as versions of one entry.
